evidence.content: In addition to the community string, an ACL can be applied that further restricts SNMP access to a select group of source IP addresses. This configuration restricts SNMP read-only access to end host devices that reside in the 192.168.100.0/24 address space and restricts SNMP readwrite access to only the end host device at 192.168.100.1. Note: The devices that are permitted by these ACLs require the proper community string in order to access the requested SNMP information.
